long_biography.plain_text:
Thenamaris grew from the shipping business established by Ioanna Martinou’s grandmother, Athina, into one of Greece’s largest family maritime groups. Martinou belongs to the third generation of that enterprise and is a co-owner and board member of Thenamaris Ships Management. The company now manages tankers, gas carriers, bulk carriers and containerships from its base near Athens.

Martinou has represented Thenamaris on the board of the Hellenic Marine Environment Protection Association since 2020. That position is distinct from the relatives responsible for the shipping group’s daily management. It nevertheless gives her a formal role in industry governance and collective work on cleaner seas. Separately, she owns NIGMA, a real-estate business.

uncertainties: The upstream owner record provides the exact La Belle relationship but no biography or public ownership chain. Identity clears the gate because the uncommon Greek name, nationality, residence, commercial-maritime context, Thenamaris company, Martinou family generation and institutional portrait records converge; the public La Belle page confirms the vessel but does not independently name her.

Ioanna Martinou is also the name of an Athens leadership consultant associated with Mind Made Consulting. That profile has no Thenamaris, NIGMA, HELMEPA, Athina I. Martinou Foundation or maritime-family anchors and was treated as a namesake rather than proposed as a social profile.

Institutional sources alternate Ioanna C. Martinou and Ioanna K. Martinou, while one English-language Hall of Fame page uses Ioanna Martinos. These appear consistent with Greek patronymic and gendered surname transliteration, but no middle name is proposed because K or C may represent Konstantinou or Constantinos as a patronymic rather than a conventional middle name.

Forbes profiles Constantinos Martinos & family, not Ioanna individually. Its family-company scale and wealth classification inform the underlying Thenamaris context only; no Forbes net-worth figure, self-made label or personal asset estimate is transferred to Ioanna.

Marriage / family transfer is inferred at medium confidence because Athina Martinou founded the family shipping platform, Ioanna is identified as her granddaughter and a third-generation successor, and current reporting identifies Ioanna as a Thenamaris co-owner. The transferor, timing and legal instrument remain undisclosed, so the dossier does not claim Inherited, Inherited and expanded or Mixed.

Heir / family shareholder describes Martinou's current relationship because co-ownership and a company board role are documented while Forbes identifies Nikolas Martinos as the person running Thenamaris. The label does not decide whether her stake was inherited or transferred during life and does not diminish her separate foundation leadership.

NIGMA ownership is supported by Ae4ria, but no reliable public accounts establish the portfolio, value, operating team or relative contribution of that real-estate business. It is included as a secondary role but does not displace Shipping & Maritime as the primary industry or support a real-estate tag.

The single Commercial ship management tag is deliberately minimal. Co-ownership plus a company board role satisfies its substantial-control contract; tanker, gas-carrier, dry-bulk and container tags are omitted because sources do not allocate specific segment responsibility to Martinou personally, and Commercial shipowner is omitted because day-to-day ownership practice is not established.

No reliable exact birth day, place of birth, secondary nationality, personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X/Twitter or personal website was verified. The stored March 1976 birth data is preserved without being re-proposed or repeated in the biographies.

The display-name proposal removes Mrs only because the title is already held in a separate source field and exact-name sources render Ioanna Martinou. The immutable owner snapshot retains Mrs Ioanna Martinou exactly as exported.

Both biographies exclude La Belle, registry language, current fleet counts, family net worth and source attribution. They distinguish the mature family platform from Martinou's personally documented foundation work and remain independent of asset-sale context.
